decisions.decision: Scale allowlist is all 157 Sonic Pi scale names, not a curated subset
decisions.rationale: D-11 assumed ~40 names, but the installed Sonic Pi defines 157. A subset would make D-11's 'any scale name Sonic Pi itself knows' false.

decisions.decision: The Ruby-side seeded Random draws the per-degree weight permutation and rotation options
decisions.rationale: D-04 puts randomness in note order, which is symbolic and resolved by Sonic Pi at runtime — without a consumer, Random.new(seed) would have had nothing to do and GEN-02 would have been vacuous.

decisions.decision: OSC ack port is 4700, not the research sketch's 4559
decisions.rationale: 4559 sits inside Sonic Pi's own 4557-4561 internal port block; 4700 cannot collide. Overridable via environment variable.

decisions.decision: Stop-all is a per-step Time State flag, not a loop-name registry
decisions.rationale: A live_loop redefinition only takes effect on the loop's next iteration — up to four bars away — which is too slow for a panic command. RESEARCH.md Open Question 1 recommended the minimal version for Phase 1; generalize in Phase 4.

decisions.decision: GEN-04 is satisfied via Sonic Pi's chord_degree rather than a literal scale call
decisions.rationale: chord_degree is the scale-parameterised chord primitive, so Chord.resolve_degree builds voicings out of the named scale itself — an out-of-scale pitch becomes impossible by construction rather than filtered after the fact, which is what makes GEN-06 structural. FLAGGED: a strict reading of GEN-04's 'scale/chord' wording could expect a bare scale call.
